hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$ROOT" ]; then echo "[hook:prisma-validate] BLOCKED: cannot resolve repository root (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset and git rev-parse failed); guard did NOT run"; exit 1; fi; cd "$ROOT" || { echo "[hook:prisma-validate] BLOCKED: cannot enter repository root; guard did NOT run"; exit 1; }; if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'schema\.prisma'; then echo "[hook:prisma-validate] running: prisma/schema.prisma changed"; OUT=$(npx prisma validate 2>&1); RC=$?; echo "$OUT" | tail -8; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then echo "[hook:prisma-validate] PASSED"; else echo "[hook:prisma-validate] FAILED (exit $RC)"; exit 1; fi; else echo "[hook:prisma-validate] skipped: prisma/schema.prisma not modified"; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '"git commit"\|git commit -'; then ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$ROOT" ]; then echo "[hook:recurrence-scan] BLOCKED: cannot resolve repository root (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset and git rev-parse failed); guard did NOT run"; exit 1; fi; cd "$ROOT" || { echo "[hook:recurrence-scan] BLOCKED: cannot enter repository root; guard did NOT run"; exit 1; }; echo "[hook:recurrence-scan] running: git commit detected"; OUT=$(node scripts/scan-recurrence-defects.mjs --pre-commit 2>&1); RC=$?; echo "$OUT" | grep -E 'VIOLATION|ERROR' | head -5; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then echo "[hook:recurrence-scan] PASSED"; else echo "[hook:recurrence-scan] FAILED (exit $RC)"; exit 1; fi; fi
